apps.name: Gas Pipe Sizing Workbook
apps.idea: US fuel gas pipe sizing workflow: sum loads and developed lengths, convert units both ways, keep every input editable, and record which code edition and table each reading came from. Ships no code tables; results verify against your own book.
apps.killReason: Never released and never earned: check-outcomes reports NO-DATA, no Play Console reading was ever recorded, the pack still points at the reserved host example.com, and three core promises - returns-the-missing-values, records-the-citation, shows-its-arithmetic - were weakened with no recorded ownerDecision, so the slot no longer delivers the reasons it was chosen for. Killed on the owner's direction 2026-09-30.

apps.name: Mark Book for Teachers
apps.idea: Private offline classroom record book a teacher owns: create, edit and delete every class, student, assignment, grade, attendance mark, note, parent contact and seating position without an account or a server, see an explainable running average, export CSV and PDF, and keep a restorable backup file. Free for one class, unlocked once for unlimited classes and export.
apps.publishedNote: The owner reported the app approved and live on Google Play in session, and that he installed it himself from the store page. This is the date the fact was recorded, not a console-verified approval date; nobody read Play Console's own date.

apps.name: Lawn Round Log
apps.idea: An offline lawn round log a solo mower owns outright: ordered customers, one-tap visits, owed balances and CSV export, unlocked once.

apps.name: Laneset: Swim Set Builder
apps.idea: A swim set builder that computes each session from the swimmer's own constraints (minutes, pool length, focus, strokes to avoid, gear on deck) against authored programming rules, walks them through the two pace trials that put a target time on every interval, and prints or shares the set list; one-time unlock, offline, no account.
apps.submittedNote: 11 changes sent for Play review from Console publishing overview on 2026-10-04; page reads Изменения на проверке. Status stays building until the listing is live — published is only after Play approval.

apps.name: UnitWalk
apps.idea: UnitWalk — a crash-safe, no-account rental unit walk for self-managing landlords: room-by-room photo condition records that survive a process kill, move-in versus move-out compare per unit, and a signed PDF shared from the phone.
apps.releaseNote: Implementation, tests, on-device verification and the signed release artifacts (dist/ APK + AAB) are complete, and the owner's release approval is recorded for this revision. Status stays building until the listing is live — published is only after Play approval.

apps.name: Lumintra: Light Planner
apps.idea: Offline-first light and night-sky session planner: a scrubbable night scene with your own horizon, dark window, moon, targets, satellite passes and cloud forecast for a saved spot
